custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active, tracked part, part A, for this test, with nothing on hand (quantity 0).
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425771-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425771-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off.

Step 3:

  • It saves with no confirmation and part A reads "Not Tracked".

Step 4:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off.

Step 5:

  • The switch turns on.

Step 6:

  • It saves and part A's Total Qty shows 0 again.

Step 7:

  • Two entries show, newest first: "Tracking turned on" and "Tracking turned off", written even with 0 on hand.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S10-R22: “Turning tracking off writes the entry "Tracking turned off" to the part's Part History, and turning it on writes "Tracking turned on". A part with nothing on hand still gets the entry.”
  • S5-R5: “Turning tracking off asks for no confirmation, whatever the part holds.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
